battle.name: 阿根廷內戰
battle.theater: 布宜諾斯艾利斯與拉普拉塔
battle.brief: 一八一四年，統治拉普拉塔的中央政府與各省軍頭的裂痕公開化。統轄政府試圖把首都遷往阿爾托帕拉納，隨即引發軍官叛亂。十月，老兵部隊武裝倒戈，鄉村民兵進城支持，馬丁·羅德里格斯就任總督，「第三騎兵團」被繳械；北方國民軍在維爾卡普希歐被王室軍擊潰，長槍的功能由騎兵長矛接手。

kit.name: 長槍
kit.history: 方陣的長矛讓火槍隊站在後面。密西西比之後，長矛和火槍一起站住了。

countries: 一八一四年的阿根廷內戰，形式上是拉普拉塔聯合省內部中央政府與各省軍頭的權力之爭，實際上是一場由三支力量互相擠壓的國內戰爭。第一支是布宜諾斯艾利斯中央政府：一八一三年土庫曼召開的第二次自由人民代表大會設立了「至高統轄」，一八一四年一月二十五日由安東尼奧·岡薩雷斯·德·巴爾卡塞出任第一任統轄；政府試圖把首都從布宜諾斯艾利斯遷往阿爾托帕拉納的鹽沼地帶，把軍隊與稅源搬到遠離港口的地方，切斷各省軍頭的地盤，遷都計畫因此把中央政府同時推到了駐防軍官與地方貴族的對面。第二支是省級的聯邦派勢力，各自以民兵與土地為依托：布宜諾斯艾利斯鄉村的鄉土民兵及其領袖胡安·曼努埃爾·德·羅薩斯、巴拉那邊的埃斯坦尼斯拉奧·洛佩斯、恩特雷里奧斯的法蘭西斯科·拉米雷斯、班達奧里恩塔爾的何塞·赫爾瓦西奧·阿蒂加斯，都是以省為單位、以武裝為基座的勢力。第三支是王室軍隊：西班牙王室在拉普拉塔的遠征軍由何塞·德·拉·塞爾納率領，自上秘魯壓下，構成本國一切內部矛盾的外在壓力。雙方的指揮體系差距很大：中央政府有國民軍、「第三騎兵團」這支武裝民兵和「蒂利科斯方陣」這樣的老兵部隊，政治骨幹是總督府、軍官與教士；省級勢力則是民兵組織，命令靠口頭傳達，薪餉與裝備自籌，裝備更簡陋，鬥志與地利卻遠勝於中央軍。值得注意的是，一八一四年時這些未來的聯邦派領袖多數仍是王室軍的軍官或出身地方民兵的退役軍人，他們的反叛尚未成形，這一點使一八一四年的衝突更像是內戰的前奏而非主體。
countriesEn: The Argentine civil war of 1814 was formally a struggle for authority between the central government of the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata and the provincial caudillos, but in substance a domestic war in which three forces pressed against one another. The first was the central government in Buenos Aires: the Second Congress of the Free Peoples of the Tucumán, meeting in 1813, created the Directorio Supremo, and on 25 January 1814 Antonio González de Balcarce became its first Supremo Director. The government tried to move the capital from Buenos Aires to the salt flats of the Alto Paraná, carrying the army and the revenues away from the port and cutting the provincial caudillos off from their own ground; the relocation plan therefore drove the central government simultaneously into confrontation with the garrison officers and the provincial notables. The second force was the provincial federalist interest, rooted in local militias and land: the rural militias of the Buenos Aires countryside and their leader Juan Manuel de Rosas; Estanislao López on the Paraná; Francisco Ramírez in Entre Ríos; and José Gervasio Artigas in the Banda Oriental. Each held power through a province and an armed organisation. The third was the royal army: José de la Serna's royalist force coming down from the Upper Peru, an external pressure on every internal dispute. The two command systems were very unequal. The central government had the Army of the North, the mounted militia known as the Tercero, and veteran units such as the Frontón de los Tilichos, with the viceregal administration, the officers and the clergy as its political backbone. The provincial interest was a militia organisation: orders passed by word of mouth, pay and equipment found locally, armament more primitive, but morale and local knowledge far above that of the central army. It should be noted that in 1814 most of the future federalist leaders were still royalist officers or retired men of the local militias; their rebellion had not yet taken shape, which makes the conflict of 1814 rather the prelude to the civil war than its substance.
people: 中央方面的關鍵人物是安東尼奧·岡薩雷斯·德·巴爾卡塞，一八一四年一月二十五日出任第一任至高統轄，他是個沒有政治根基的軍人出身統治者，遷都計畫正是他任內最雄心也最脆弱的一步；胡安·何塞·維阿蒙特此前任布宜諾斯艾利斯總督，十月二十日的老兵倒戈直接推翻了他；他任內最大的成就是維持政府不致瓦解，最終在遷都失敗後把總督職務交給馬丁·羅德里格斯。馬丁·羅德里格斯是邊防步兵出身的老將，十月二十六日由鄉村民兵的支持當選總督，此後五年依靠同一批人的支持維持局面，與鄉村民兵首領胡安·曼努埃爾·德·羅薩斯的關係由此奠定。鄉村民兵在十月二十日事件中決定了勝負，這位後來被稱為「復原者」的莊園領袖，第一次在首都的局面上直接出手。曼努埃爾·貝爾格拉諾以軍事代表身分出席代表大會，主張把政府移到安全的地點並儘快解決對外戰爭，與統轄派互為盟友。反對遷都的以駐防阿爾托帕拉納的軍官為首，以弗朗西斯科·費爾南德斯·德·拉·克魯斯等人為首，叛變在省內被平定。何塞·德·聖馬丁是一八一四年北方國民軍的指揮者，他年初接掌國民軍，隨即在高原上進行了一次失利的遠征，十月十九日在維爾卡普希歐被王室軍擊潰，十一月八日又在克夫拉達洪達的狹谷裡被殲滅殘部，軍隊、炮隊與輜重盡失，他隨後離開北方。何塞·德·拉·塞爾納是打垮北方軍隊的王室將領。首都內部，十月二十日倒戈的老兵以下士官耶塞·克萊門特等為首，而平定叛亂的是受命出動的「騎兵 近衛團」與城內的獵兵志願隊。何塞·赫爾瓦西奧·阿蒂加斯在形勢失利後於六月十九日與中央政府達成卡阿瓜蘇協議，退出前台，退往東方。
peopleEn: The central figure on the government side was Antonio González de Balcarce, who became the first Supremo Director on 25 January 1814. A soldier without a political base, he presided over the most ambitious and most fragile step of his administration, the plan to move the capital. Juan José Viamonte, governor of Buenos Aires before him, was overthrown directly by the veterans' rising of 20 October; his chief achievement had been keeping the government from collapsing at all, and he handed the governorship over to Martín Rodríguez once the relocation plan had failed. Rodríguez was an old colonel of the frontier infantry, elected governor on 26 October with the support of the rural militias, and governed for five more years on the strength of the same support; his relationship with Juan Manuel de Rosas, the leader of the countryside militias and the man later called the Restorer, was fixed in these days. It was the rural militia that decided the outcome on 20 October, and this was the first time that the landowner from the estates of the countryside intervened directly in the affairs of the capital. Manuel Belgrano sat in the Congress as a military deputy, arguing for moving the government to a secure place and for a quick decision on the war abroad, an ally of the Directorio party. The opposition to the relocation was headed by the officers of the Alto Paraná garrison, with Francisco Fernández de la Cruz among those who led the mutiny; the revolt was put down inside the province. José de San Martín commanded the Army of the North in 1814. He took it over at the beginning of the year, launched an ill-fated expedition across the plateau, was beaten by the royalists at Vilcapugio on 19 October, and lost the remnant of his command in the ravine of the Quebrada Honda on 8 November, together with the guns, the baggage and the camp followers; he left the north afterwards. José de la Serna was the royalist general who destroyed the northern army. In the capital the rising of 20 October was led by veterans under sergeants such as José Clemente, and it was put down by the Mounted Grenadiers sent out by the government together with the city's volunteer hunters. José Gervasio Artigas, his position having collapsed, made the Peace of Caaguazú with the central government on 19 June and withdrew from the stage towards the east.
kits: 長槍在拉普拉塔的戰爭裡有兩重身分：一是它早已退出的痕跡，二是它真正被繼承下去的功能。西班牙殖民與早期國民軍的步兵連裡，士官階級以桿兵器為職銜的象徵，這一歐洲傳統在布宜諾斯艾利斯的老兵部隊中仍看得到痕跡；然而真正在戰場上承擔長槍任務的，是「第三騎兵團」與各省市鎮騎兵手中的長矛——長矛讓騎兵在衝鋒時不必開火，衝鋒本身成為決定勝負的動作，這正是長槍方陣原理在草原上的翻版。裝備方面，中央政府的步兵裝備平滑膛燧發步槍與刺刀，輕步兵與獵兵用獵槍，騎兵用卡賓槍、手槍與長矛，炮兵是四磅、六磅、八磅與十二磅滑膛野戰炮及臼炮，另有少量騎兵炮；後勤靠牛車、騾車與木船，鄉村聯邦派民兵則多帶獵槍、馬刀與套索鞭，糧食自備。北方戰線的裝備問題尤其突出：一八一四年遠征上秘魯的國民軍在高原上缺乏騾馬與飼料，行軍數日即耗盡牲畜，結果是一支兩千餘人的隊伍在維爾卡普希歐連同炮隊、輜重與大批隨軍人員一起被擄獲——這是這場內戰裡裝備與後勤最具決定性的一課，也是後來聖馬丁重整軍隊、改革行軍與輜重制度的直接原因。
kitsEn: The pike has two identities in the war of the Río de la Plata: it is a trace of something already departed, and it is the function that was genuinely inherited. In Spanish colonial and early national infantry the NCO class carried a polearm as the badge of its rank, and traces of that European practice can still be seen in the veteran units of Buenos Aires. The weapons that actually did the pike's work on the battlefield, however, were the lances of the Tercero and of the provincial mounted men: a lance let the horseman charge without firing, so that the charge itself became the decisive act. This is the principle of the pike square turned out on the pampas. As for the equipment, the central infantry carried smoothbore flintlock muskets with bayonets, light infantry and hunters used rifles, the cavalry used carbines, pistols and lances, and the artillery was four-, six-, eight- and twelve-pounder smoothbore guns with howitzers, plus a little horse artillery. The rear areas relied on ox carts, mule trains and wooden boats, while the rural federalist militias carried rifles, sabres and lassos and fed themselves from their own resources. The equipment problem on the northern front was the most acute of all: the Army of the North that campaigned into the Upper Peru in 1814 had too few mules and too little fodder on the plateau, and within days of the march the animals were gone. A force of a little over two thousand men was therefore lost at Vilcapugio together with its guns, its baggage and a large part of its camp followers. That was the most decisive lesson in equipment and supply of the whole civil war, and it was the direct reason for the reform of the march and baggage system that San Martín later carried out.
tactics: 一八一四年中央政府與地方軍頭之間，衝突主要以「編制」而非會戰的方式進行。統轄政府的戰術是：重新排列軍隊與首都的位置，用遷都在地理上切開省級的既得利益者，用統一的募兵與薪餉制度削弱民兵對地方首領的依賴，同時把步兵的基本動作從白刃衝鋒改為火槍射擊——三排縱隊，第一排跪姿射擊，第二排裝填，第三排立姿備戰，刺刀直到最後一刻才裝上，這套射擊動作是從西班牙本土引入的標準。鄉村民兵在十月二十日事件中的表現說明另一種邏輯：民兵不是為守住某個陣地而存在，而是為了在政治上決定誰佔據首都而存在，他們的戰鬥方式是封鎖路口、切斷通訊、列隊進城，並且是站在自己支持的一方那邊作戰。反過來，聯邦派在省內的擴張用的是另一套辦法：以省為單位，平時靠地方司法與稅收維持合法性，一旦中央軍進入，立刻轉為騷擾式的遊擊——切斷糧道、隱匿在邊界地帶的莊園裡，使缺乏地方支持的中央軍無法在陌生地形中持久佔領。北方戰線則提供第三種教訓：國民軍試圖以縱隊急行穿越高原，卻在沒有飼料的情況下損失了一半騾馬，結果在維爾卡普希歐被王室軍以密集縱隊正面擊潰；撤退時在克夫拉達洪達狹谷被殲，裝備、火炮與隨軍人員全部遺失。
tacticsEn: Between the central government and the provincial caudillos in 1814 the conflict was fought mainly through organisation rather than through set-piece battle. The tactics of the Directorio were to rearrange the army and the position of the capital, to cut the provincial vested interests off geographically by moving the seat of government, to weaken the dependence of the militias on local notables through a single system of recruitment and pay, and at the same time to make musket fire rather than the charge the basic action of the infantry: three ranks, the first kneeling and firing, the second passing cartridges, the third standing and ready, with the bayonet fixed only at the last moment. This was the standard drill imported from metropolitan Spain. The conduct of the rural militia in the affair of 20 October illustrates a different logic. The militia did not exist to hold some position in the field; it existed to decide politically who would occupy the capital, and its mode of action was to close the roads, cut the communications and march into the city in formation, and it fought on the side of the faction it backed. The reverse was true of the federalist expansion inside the provinces, which worked through the province: legitimacy in normal times from local justice and taxation, and, as soon as the central army entered, an immediate turn to harassing irregular warfare — cutting supply lines and hiding on the estates of the frontier zone, so that a central army without local support could not hold ground in country it did not know. The northern front provided a third lesson. The Army of the North tried to cross the plateau in hurried columns, lost half its mules for want of fodder, and was smashed in the face by the royalist massed columns at Vilcapugio; in the retreat the remnant was annihilated in the Quebrada Honda ravine, leaving guns, equipment and camp followers behind.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。一八一四年一月二十五日，第二屆自由人民代表大會在土庫曼設立「至高統轄」，安東尼奧·岡薩雷斯·德·巴爾卡塞出任第一任統轄；同年四月，駐防阿爾托帕拉納的軍官團因拒絕遷都安排而叛變，叛軍隨後在省內的收復行動以失敗告終；七月五日，統轄政府下令繳械「第三騎兵團」；六月二十九日（部分史料作六月十九日），阿蒂加斯與中央政府達成卡阿瓜蘇協議；十月二十日，以「第一線」與「蒂利科斯方陣」老兵為主的城內部隊武裝倒戈，十月二十六日由民兵支持的馬丁·羅德里格斯就任總督。兵力方面，布宜諾斯艾利斯的常備正規軍不過數千人，「第三騎兵團」與「第一線」老兵合計約一兩千人，「蒂利科斯方陣」為數百人的精銳，獵兵志願隊數百人，鄉村民兵可集合數千人；北方國民軍在維爾卡普希歐投入的兵力約二千六百人，面對王室軍約六千人。此役國民軍的損失在數百至一千餘人之間，炮隊、輜重與大批隨軍人員被擄獲。整段衝突的時間尺度以月計：從遷都計畫的失敗到十月的政變，再到一八一五年一月統轄政府把首都遷回布宜諾斯艾利斯，內部裂痕始終沒有靠戰鬥解決。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. On 25 January 1814 the Second Congress of the Free Peoples at Tucumán created the Directorio Supremo and Antonio González de Balcarce became its first Supremo Director. In April of that year the officers of the Alto Paraná garrison mutinied against the relocation arrangements, and the attempt to reduce the rebels inside the province ended in failure. On 5 July the government ordered the disarming of the Tercero. On 19 or 29 June, according to the source, Artigas reached the Peace of Caaguazú with the central government. On 20 October the veteran units of the city, the Primera Línea and the Frontón de los Tilichos, rose in arms, and on 26 October Martín Rodríguez was elected governor with the support of the militias. On men: the regular standing army of Buenos Aires numbered only some thousands; the Tercero and the veterans of the Primera Línea together came to perhaps a thousand or two; the Frontón de los Tilichos was a picked body of a few hundred; the volunteer hunters were a few hundred more; and the rural militias could raise several thousand. At Vilcapugio the Army of the North committed about two thousand six hundred men against some six thousand royalists. Losses there ran from several hundred to over a thousand men, with the guns, the baggage and a large part of the camp followers captured. The whole conflict is measured in months: from the failure of the relocation scheme to the rising of October, and on to the return of the capital to Buenos Aires by the Directorio in January 1815, the internal rupture was never settled by fighting.
cause: 打起來的原因，是一八一〇年代以來國家建設的錢和兵都不夠。第一是財政：中央政府要養活國民軍、支付軍官薪俸，同時維持兩條戰線，而港口收入與各省稅收都被地方中間人截留，硬通貨與地方貨幣並流通，軍隊欠餉成了常態，欠餉直接變成兵變，兵變又變成省級擴張的契機。第二是權力來源：各省的軍隊都是本地人，效忠的是省級的顯赫人物而不是中央；中央政府唯一能做的，是用職位和薪餉把地方軍官收編進自己的編制，而這種收編與各省的抵抗本來就是同一件事。第三是地理：布宜諾斯艾利斯是唯一能徵稅、徵兵、徵船的港口，也是唯一通往歐洲的通道，中央政府的任何計畫都必須以這座城市為中心；省級勢力恰恰希望權力留在本地，統轄政府把首都遷往阿爾托帕拉納，正是想用「中央」這個抽象去對抗「省」這個現實，結果只激起更多武裝抵抗。第四，也是最深的一層：上秘魯的王室軍戰線把中央政府的注意力、稅收與精銳全部吸走，北方軍隊的覆沒使中央在國內一時毫無可用之兵，省級軍頭與省級議會趁機擴張，於是原本的革命戰爭，在一八一四年前後變成了一場中央與各省的內部爭端。
causeEn: The war came about because the money and the men for building a state were not there. First, finance: the central government had to feed the Army of the North, pay the officers' salaries and maintain two fronts at once, while harbour revenues and provincial taxes were skimmed by local intermediaries and hard currency circulated alongside local money. Troop arrears became the norm, arrears turned directly into mutiny, and mutiny became the opening for provincial expansion. Second, the source of power: every province's army was made up of local men loyal to provincial notables rather than to the centre. The only thing the central government could do was to enlist the provincial officers into its own order of battle by rank and pay, and that enlistment and provincial resistance were two names for the same process. Third, geography: Buenos Aires was the only port where taxes, men and ships could be found and the only channel to Europe, so every plan of the central government had to be built on that city, while the provincial interest wanted power to stay where it was. Moving the capital to the Alto Paraná was an attempt to use the abstraction of the centre against the reality of the province, and it only raised more armed resistance. Fourth, and deepest of all, the royalist front in the Upper Peru drained the government's attention, its revenue and its best troops; the destruction of the northern army left the centre without a usable field force in the country, and the provincial commanders and legislatures expanded into the gap. The revolution thus turned, around 1814, into a quarrel between the centre and the provinces.
impact: 影響沿著幾條線索展開。第一條是首都問題：阿爾托帕拉納遷都計畫的失敗，斷送了統一派把權力中心移出布宜諾斯艾利斯的嘗試，一八一五年統轄政府把首都搬回原處，此後二十年中央政府再也沒有能力真正離開這座城市，這一點直接決定了後來內戰的全部走向。第二條是軍隊的解體：繳械第三騎兵團是老兵武裝第一次被中央解除，結果等於把一支能打仗的騎兵隊推向地方，聯邦制的想法在軍隊內部先於在思想上成熟，一八二〇年之後省級武裝的迅速擴張，源頭就在這一紙命令。第三條是北方戰線的崩潰：維爾卡普希歐的敗仗切斷了南部上秘魯的遊擊區，拉普拉塔的北方自此難有正面戰場，獨立運動的地理格局因此改變，許多年輕軍官轉身投向更遠的戰場，戰爭的規模與影響都在新的方向上展開。第四條是政治文化的成型：十月二十日的老兵倒戈與鄉村民兵進城，成了此後布宜諾斯艾利斯政治中最常見的解決模型——以武裝力量決定首都歸屬；而一八一四年把城鄉民兵的主導權握在羅薩斯手上，也替這位「復原者」攢下了未來二三十年的政治資本，這一點要等到一八二〇年的重大危機才完全顯現。
impactEn: The effects run along several lines. The first is the question of the capital. The failure of the Alto Paraná project destroyed the unitary attempt to move the seat of power out of Buenos Aires; in 1815 the Directorio brought the capital back, and for twenty years afterwards the central government never again had the strength to leave that city. This single fact governed the whole course of the later civil war. The second is the disarmament of an army. The order that stripped the Tercero of its weapons was the first time the central authority disarmed a veterans' militia, and the effect was to push a serviceable mounted force into the provinces: the federal idea matured inside the army before it matured in the political discussion, and the rapid provincial expansion after 1820 traces straight back to that single order. The third is the collapse of the northern front. Vilcapugio cut the partisan zone of the southern Upper Peru away from the capital, and from then on the north of the Río de la Plata had no field theatre of its own; the geography of the independence movement changed, and a generation of young officers turned to theatres further afield, and the war grew in scale and reach in new directions. The fourth is the formation of a political culture. The rising of the veterans on 20 October and the entry of the rural militia into the city became the standard model for solving the question of the capital in Buenos Aires politics thereafter: the question of the capital settled by armed force. And by taking the lead of the rural militia in 1814, Rosas had banked the political capital of the next two or three decades for himself, a thing that only became fully apparent at the great crisis of 1820.
result: 就一八一四年這一段而言，結果可以分成三層。軍事上，十月二十日的政變被壓制，武裝的老兵被解除武裝，北方國民軍全軍覆沒，中央政府沒有取得任何決定性的戰場勝利。政治上，結果是中央與地方的權力天平倒向地方：布宜諾斯艾利斯總督由鄉村民兵扶上位的馬丁·羅德里格斯開啟了一段長達五年的相對穩定期，他必須靠鄉村民兵的支持維持位置，這一依賴關係日後在政局動盪中會付出代價；阿蒂加斯退出政治與戰鬥，退往東方，聯邦派的活動中心由東方轉向聖菲與恩特雷里奧斯，埃斯坦尼斯拉奧·洛佩斯與法蘭西斯科·拉米雷斯在一八一六至一八二〇年間才由王室軍軍官轉身為省級軍頭，一八二〇年的全國崩潰才使「聯邦派」成為有明確綱領的政治力量。制度上，統轄政府把首都搬回布宜諾斯艾利斯，於是一八一六年召開的第三屆代表大會得以在這座城市裡舉行，七月九日通過的《獨立宣言》正是在這個前提下完成：內戰沒有解決國家的形式，卻把國家的所在地確定下來，讓獨立這個議題有了一個可以操作的舞台。
resultEn: For the year 1814 itself the result can be read on three levels. Militarily, the rising of 20 October was suppressed, the armed veterans were disarmed, the Army of the North was destroyed, and the central government won no decisive field engagement. Politically, the balance of power tipped towards the provinces. Martín Rodríguez, installed as governor of Buenos Aires with the support of the rural militia, opened five years of relative calm, but he had to keep his position on the support of the same men, and that dependence would one day be paid for in the turbulence to come. Artigas withdrew from politics and from the fighting and fell back towards the east; the centre of federalist activity moved from the east to Santa Fe and Entre Ríos, and Estanislao López and Francisco Ramírez only turned from royalist officers into provincial caudillos between 1816 and 1820. The collapse of 1820 was what turned federalism into a movement with a clear programme. Institutionally, the Directorio brought the capital back to Buenos Aires, and the Third Congress was therefore able to sit in that city in 1816, where on 9 July the Declaration of Independence was carried. The civil war did not settle the form of the state; it settled where the state would be, and in doing so it gave the question of independence a stage on which it could be worked.
